name: Green Cabinets NY
subtitle: Custom cabinets in AR + scan
promotionalText: Scan your kitchen with your iPhone and send Green Cabinets the measured room. We plan your custom cabinets from the real walls and reply within 24 hours.
description:
Custom kitchen cabinets, vanities, closets and millwork for New York homes, designed in Bushwick since 2009.

CABINETS IN YOUR ROOM, IN AR
Stand in your kitchen and place real-size cabinets with the camera: base, drawer, wall and pantry cabinets. Drag them into place, line up a run, and switch every door between oak, walnut and painted finishes. Take pictures and send them to us. Works on any recent iPhone or iPad.

MEASURE WITH THE CAMERA
A tape measure in your camera for walls, gaps and windows, in feet and inches, inches or centimeters. Pictures keep the lengths written on them.

SCAN YOUR DRAWINGS
Architect's plans, a building floor plan or a sketch on paper: the scanner finds the page, straightens it and sends it for a price.

SCAN THE WHOLE ROOM
On an iPhone or iPad with LiDAR, walk your kitchen for about two minutes. The app measures every wall, door, window and existing cabinet, then shows the room in 3D. Pick single walls to send as flat drawings with sizes. Every scan and picture is marked confidential and made for your project with Green Cabinets NY.

SEE THE WORK
Kitchens, vanities, walk-in closets and built-ins from Brooklyn, Manhattan and Queens, from the first drawing to the finished room.

REAL PRICES UP FRONT
What NYC kitchens cost with us, by size, before the first visit.

BUILT FOR NEW YORK BUILDINGS
Co-op and condo paperwork, certificates of insurance, freight elevators, quiet hours, crooked pre-war walls. We plan around your building from day one.

MATERIALS
Compare 14 hardwoods and browse real panel decors from Tafisa, Egger, Shinnoki, Wilsonart and AGT, with product codes.

By appointment only. We bring door and finish samples to your home in Brooklyn, Manhattan and Queens.
reviewNotes:
Thank you for reviewing Green Cabinets NY. We rebuilt the app around native features that work on every iPhone and iPad, including devices without LiDAR.

Green Cabinets NY designs and installs custom kitchen cabinets in New York. The app is how clients plan a project from their own room. A tab bar at the bottom (Home, Scan, AR, Measure, Quote) opens each native tool.

1. AR tab: cabinets in your room (ARKit + RealityKit, any device). Tap "Open the camera", move the device over the floor, then tap the floor to place a real-size cabinet. Drag to move it, rotate with two fingers, tap "Add next" to line up a run. The round chips switch every door to a different finish (oak, walnut, painted colors). The shutter takes pictures; Done brings them back, and they can be sent to us.

2. Measure tab: a tape measure in the camera (ARKit raycasting, any device). Point the ring at one end of a wall, tap +, move to the other end, tap + again. Lengths show on the lines and in feet and inches, inches or centimeters. Pictures are saved with the lengths written on them.

3. Quote tab: Apple's document scanner (VisionKit) for floor plans and drawings. Pages are found, flattened and cleaned up, then sent to our office with the client's details.

4. Scan tab: a full 3D room scan with RoomPlan on LiDAR devices (iPhone Pro, iPad Pro). On other devices, "See a sample scan" opens the same native-data 3D viewer with a sample room.

Everything the client sends arrives by email at our office; there are no accounts, sign-in, purchases or ads. The camera is used only for these tools.

Contact: orders@greencabinetsny.com, (718) 804-5488.
